app_links.ios_note: No dedicated Microsoft Rewards app. Points are earned via the Bing mobile app, Microsoft Edge mobile app, Xbox app, or the web dashboard at rewards.microsoft.com while signed in with a Microsoft account.

biggest_catch: Daily earning is hard-capped (e.g. 150 points/day from PC search at Level 2), so a $5 gift card takes weeks of daily use — and Level 2 perks require earning 500+ points every month.
catches: Point earning limits apply: PC search capped per day (50 Level 1 / 150 Level 2); mobile search capped at 100/day at Level 2
Level 2 requires earning at least 500 points per month
Microsoft Store purchases: subscriptions and gift card purchases are not eligible; 20,000 points/month cap on purchase earnings
Rewards with Xbox through gameplay require age 18+ with a Microsoft account in select markets
Available only in listed markets (market list linked on page, not enumerated inline)

steps: Create a free Microsoft account (or sign in with your existing Outlook/Xbox/Windows account).
Go to https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/rewards/about and click Start earning, then visit the Rewards dashboard to fully activate your account.
Stay signed in to your Microsoft account in the Microsoft Edge browser and on Bing.
Earn points daily: search with Bing on PC (up to 150 points/day at Level 2) and on mobile via the Bing app.
Complete the daily quizzes, polls, and streak activities on your Rewards dashboard for bonus points.
Keep earning at least 500 points per month to reach and hold Level 2 for better rates.
Once you reach 1,600+ points, open the Rewards catalog and redeem for a Microsoft Store/Xbox gift card (or save to 5,000 for top-retailer gift cards).
timing: Not stated on the official page.
